profile.headline: Web Developer/Designer
profile.summary:
I am Adept at analyzing and resolving malfunctions, utilizing outstanding communication and technical skills to ensure optimal Web Application performance and minimization of downtime.
I have the Ability to create, modify and optimize web page graphics and layouts.
I am Proficient with content management systems, HTML, CSS and JavaScript, Figma, SQL.

positions.title: Freelance Web Developer
positions.description:
Developed and integrated custom HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and PHP code to optimize website architecture and enhance functionality, resulting in improved user experience and site performance.
Created comprehensive User Experience journey maps, user flows, personas, wireframes, and prototypes using Figma.
Integrated email templates into marketing automation tools, ensuring smooth execution of email campaigns.
Setup sales pipeline flows, tags in crms and added prospects to email campaigns for follow ups.
Build out email campaigns to follow up and nurture leads.
Conducted in-depth user interviews, surveys, and research to identify critical Web Accessibility Features, user behaviors, and Custom Development usability goals.
Design Email templates based on brand guidelines.
Redesigned UX interfaces with meticulous attention to Web Technologies Navigation, aligning with brand guidelines and Project Managers objectives.
Crafted persuasive copy that addressed user pain points and increased conversions as a Team Player.
Collaborated closely with clients to deliver high-quality Web Accessibility design deliverables on time.
Utilized user-centered design principles and data-driven decision-making.
Articulated design strategies and adapted designs in response to stakeholders’ input, ensuring alignment with project goals. 
Created abandon cart follow up automations
Created templates for emails, websites, sales funnels, chatbots, wireframes and automation workflows.
Created custom automation business workflows with zapier and other webhooks in crm systems
Build, design and add sales funnel automations for email follow up sequences.
Build chatbot automation flow to handle request asked questions, Dm automation and support request.
Managed multiple Projects with strong Collaboration Skills and attention to detail

positions.title: CS Programmer
positions.description:
Building web application using ASP.Net MVC in visual studio.
Fix defects in software using Java and drools.
Build out layout of application with HTML,CSS,JavaScript,Jquery and Bootstrap.
Use WinSCP to search which step the batch job failed
Use dbvisualizer to write queries to search database.
Use Jboss while testing web application

positions.title: Application Support Engineer
positions.description:
o   Respond to support requests  via chat, incoming phone calls and ticketing system (salesforce)
o   Provisioning Agents and Admins 
o   Used Sales force on daily handling at least 10 cases a day updating status, making sure all communication emails and data from chats are attached to re assign for escalations.
o   Run Manual test to replicate issues with web applications, Android and Iphone 
o   Troubleshoot and inspect JavaScript website script for Chat engagement on Car Dealership Websites
o   Read HTML and CSS to verify no conflict with chat code
o   Use HTML tags to update text in admin portal 
o   Setup Google analytics goals and event tracking 
o   Create and maintain troubleshooting knowledge base articles 
o   Troubleshoot integration issue with Facebook messenger, Google My Business and Apple business chat
o   Search Database using SQL for active user profiles and lead integration setup 
o   Escalate product bug issues 
o   Create conversation flows for automated chatbot 
o   Meeting or exceeding stated service level agreement (SLA) 
o   Perform duties under pressure in a fast-paced high volume environment 
o   Text enable landline numbers using Twilio 
o   Use Jira to check status of Software bugs

positions.title: Web Designer/developer-remote
positions.description:
o   Editing page content with cms
o   Designing web page layouts
o   Determining technical requirements
o   Update website image gallery
o   Creating backup files
o   Create buttons to link to other pages using HTML
o   Setup Google places, yelp and Facebook account information.

positions.title: Application Administrator
positions.description:
o	Help dealers setup data feed format in xml/pipe delimited
o	Manage incoming and outgoing Dealer data feeds in windows server 2008
o      Analyst for large data converting it into strategic pricing details in Excel
o	Maintain access security for assigned applications
o	Use Gotomeeting to troubleshoot dealer issues
o	Create, maintain and execute SQL statements in database
o      Update Documentation on daily and quarterly processors 
o      Run testing on Myreports analysis software for optimal performance
o	Initiate the setup of Bidpro, Myreports and troubleshoot issues
o	Analyze error log files and other files to investigate for debugging of complex issues.
o	Maintain and update Myanalyst website using Orchard 
o      continuously monitor data quality and update data in custom fields on Salesforce
o      Create pivot tables in Excel for quarterly reports
o      Document customer issues on heat ticket system and on Salesforce
o      Run SQL queries on Microsoft server management studio for quarterly 205080 market price data

positions.title: Computer Operations
positions.description:
o	Monitor and control All Distribution Centers and customer orders backups
o	Electronic data processing equipment to process business P.O.D Scanner
o	Enter commands in Unix base terminal to set controls on peripheral devices. 
o	Monitor and restore All Distribution Center system backups and overnight process
o     Change laser printer cartridges for daily and monthly reports.
o     Monitor 10 Unix command widows and respond to error messages
o    Start HQ System backup

positions.title: Inventory Stocker
positions.description:
Replenish items in A and B zone locations .
Stocking product in alpha/numeric sequence by product line.
Filled customer orders from tickets.
Used Motorola WT4000 to scan items. 
Pull kinko FedEX orders from reserve locations

positions.title: Software Tester
positions.description:
o   Help with reimage of PDT 3100 scanner
o   Ran inventory test on PDT to record scanner accuracy
o   Charged PDT to prompt for inventory test
o   Scan barcode of PDT to register store shipping number
o   wrapped and packed plastic around PDT in shipping box
o   Took apart cradle to replace and test cables

positions.title: Helpdesk Tech Support Representative
positions.description:
o   Ordered hardware replacement parts for customers with warranty
o   Apply understanding and knowledge of information systems products and services to assist customers 
     on technical matters.
o   Troubleshoot Network connectivity issues on Lenovo desktop and laptops
o   Document call detailed issues in system while on phone with customer
o   Verify warranty of Lenovo computers peripherals 
o   Recognize customer's problems that should be escalated to the next level for resolution following established protocols

positions.title: Overnight Freezer Stocker
positions.description:
o Efficiently and quickly stock assigned sections, ensuring products are placed according to company standards and that the shelves are full and well-conditioned.
o Organize and maintain the backroom/cooler: Keep the frozen food storage areas neat and organized.
o Label, stock, and inventory department merchandise: Ensure accurate labeling and inventory of frozen items.
o Review "sell by" dates and take appropriate action on items nearing or past their expiration.
o Ensure proper temperatures are maintained in freezers and coolers. 
o Monitor temperatures and maintain temperature logs to comply with food safety regulations.
o Adhere to standards related to handling, storage, and presentation of frozen foods.

positions.title: Student Computer Technician
positions.description:
o   Served as a student technician that was responsible for the overall operations of the student dorm room internet access.
o   Develop computer installation and up grading technical skills.
o   install, restore, troubleshoot and repair hardware and software within computer laboratories.
o   Provide technical support to users of College software and hardware.
o   Provide support for imaging software and hardware throughout campus resource centers.
o   Data entry for novel security accounts for students and faculty
